purpose: Bounded cross-lane scan for general lemmas/assets that may strengthen the existing BRIDGE V2 compact same-population producer without reactivating sibling lanes.

bridge_boundary.rule: This scan does not authorize broader BR204 recovery and does not replace the required hostile audit of the single-parent replacement freeze.

sources.asset: HPADJ13 direct GRF04 x Picard x4 intersection
sources.fact: Same x4 coordinate plus Picard parity turns the GRF04 interval into a residue-class capacity bound; audited uniform 7/33 bound on the then-retained x4-complete envelope.

After Picard congruences, residual feasible region becomes a nonnegative simplex and the positive diagonal Schur penalty has zero center; minimum is attained by the least nonnegative parity representative.
Parameter inequalities can make a nominal x4/cap constraint globally inactive, permitting compact-cell evaluation once and multiplicity reuse.
Full qA histogram is an audited same-population refinement of a coarser two-tier qA summary; composition is direct replacement, not additive subtraction.
Exact candidate/consumed-route overlap was represented as an identity-set accounting adapter with no-double-charge proof.
Exact overlap-union accounting and source-locked recomposition are reusable promotion patterns, but the bounded d=e=8 symbolic lemma is not a FULL178 bridge theorem.
Current MB104 leaf explicitly waits for a new adapter; retained mixed-support receiver semantics do not directly match the BRIDGE compact producer.
Shares Picard64 ambient structure but targets branch/conductor consumer data; potential semantic relation requires an explicit adapter before use.
All140 positivity has a fixed coefficient matrix; if rational infeasibility is material, Farkas cuts can project to terminal coordinates and split additively across the existing A/BC producer.

common_core: Preserve exact compact population semantics; never multiply savings.
Exploit fixed-coordinate intersections before terminal identity expansion.
Convert parity/congruence data into exact residue-class capacity or minimum-mass costs.
Prove parameter-domain constraints inactive/redundant before carrying them as state dimensions.
Use exact histograms only where bounded/full evidence shows coarse summaries leave material slack.

candidate_lemmas.name: RESIDUE_CLASS_CONVEX_INTERVAL_CAP
candidate_lemmas.statement: For a convex/sublevel x4 interval intersected with a fixed congruence class, survivor capacity is the exact arithmetic-progression count; HPADJ13 parity is the mod-2/mod-4 instance.

candidate_lemmas.name: ZERO_CENTER_POSITIVE_DIAGONAL_SIMPLEX_MIN
candidate_lemmas.statement: When the residual feasible region is a nonnegative simplex and the Schur/penalty form has zero center with positive diagonal coefficients, the global minimum in a fixed residue/parity class is its least nonnegative representative.

candidate_lemmas.name: DOMAIN_WIDE_INACTIVE_CAP
candidate_lemmas.statement: If parameter inequalities imply every per-coordinate cap exceeds the residual budget, those caps can be removed globally and compact-cell values reused with multiplicity.

candidate_lemmas.name: FIXED_MATRIX_FARKAS_TERMINAL_PROJECTION
candidate_lemmas.statement: A fixed all140 rational feasibility matrix permits reusable dual inequalities in terminal/d/e parameters; useful only if exact rational-LP preflight finds substantial real-UNSAT and coefficient signatures remain compression-compatible.

non_routes: Do not import CUT finite-ring closures as a BRIDGE global theorem.
Do not import CERTLIFT d=e=8 symbolic closure as FULL178.
Do not treat MB-FIB conductor data as Picard-mu data without an exact semantic adapter.
Do not infer a factor-two Picard saving: TD02 already used parity-max capacity.
recommended_next_research_after_required: Add a light BRX1/BRX3 verifier against the existing BR203/BR204 compact producer and measure whether they are already implied or yield strict same-population improvement.
If BRX1/BRX3 leave material slack, test BRX2 on the exact BRIDGE residual variables before adding any new state dimension.
Run BRX4 only as a bounded fail-fast rational-LP/Farkas experiment; park it if old integer UNSAT mostly becomes rational SAT.
